services.name: Dolphin Tour
services.desc: Duration 90 Minutes About Come and join the thrill and excitement of a dolphin excursion with the Rebel Water Sports crew! We explore the best the back bay of Fort Myer's Beach has to offer. It's a 26-mile adventure where we'll see dolphins, manatees, sharks, stingrays, sea turtles, and so much more! Feel free to bring your phone but our tour guides will take pictures of you for free! Reviews “We had such a great time. Everything went over smoothly and our guide was very knowledgeable.
